scope: Health Connect RMSSD -> Mi Fitness experimental sleep-interval sample summary
evidence_level: Official APK static analysis and official documentation; no account upload or device UI verification for this HRV implementation

official_apk.evidence_scope: Claims below apply to this artifact. They do not establish behavior in other app versions or every account/device configuration.

health_connect_source.time_semantics: An instantaneous timestamp and nullable source zone offset; no per-record measurement interval or guaranteed whole-night coverage.
health_connect_source.preservation: The bridge retains source package, stable record ID/revision, timestamp, offset and original Double value in its inbound model. It does not modify the source HC record.

xiaomi_schema.hrvDetailRecords: transient List<TimedValue<Integer>>; not a serialized JSON timeline field on this report
xiaomi_schema.cloud_daily_report: No HRV fields were found in the inspected CloudSleepSegment and sleep-day report models. This is not evidence for inventing a standalone hrv upload key or a daily HRV aggregate.
xiaomi_schema.upload_contract_limit: A readable/serialized model field is not proof that a cloud POST accepts it or that the official app displays an imported value.

native_data_path.observed: AllDaySleepParseData supplies timestamp, mean, extrema and additional HRV fields to the sleep-report builder. The sleep assist path parses sleep proto data, obtains HrvInfo, aggregates detail points and assigns hrvDetailRecords.
native_data_path.limitation: Three JSON summary fields do not reproduce the separate sleep proto data required for the native detailed curve.

native_algorithm.static_scan: RMSSD-named methods exist in bundled Health Connect classes and an older com.huami.algo.healthcare library. No connection from those old Huami methods to the current Xiaomi sleep-HRV report path was established. Bundled method names do not prove the current report's algorithm.

official_documents.title: Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm FAQ
official_documents.finding: Describes HRV during sleep and a multi-night baseline. It does not name RMSSD. The page is an automatic translation of an English article.

official_documents.title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 FAQ
official_documents.finding: Describes sleep HRV; no explicit RMSSD equivalence was established. Device-specific baseline guidance is not generalized to all app versions.

ui_and_baseline.summary_gate: If report.sid resolves to DeviceInfo with isPhone=true, hide the panel. Otherwise avgHrv must be non-null and positive; the value is formatted in milliseconds. This method does not check hrvAnalysisTimestamp.
ui_and_baseline.summary_limit: An unresolved sid is not rejected by this method alone. How the actual manual-import sid resolves, upstream report selection and final device UI behavior remain untested; display is not guaranteed.
ui_and_baseline.baseline_gate: Requires hrvAnalysisTimestamp > 0 AND at least one positive value among avgHrv, hrvStd, hrvMedian, hrvLowerQuantile, hrvMiddleQuantile and hrvUpperQuantile.
ui_and_baseline.baseline_limit: A new three-field summary without analysis timestamp does not by itself pass this predicate. Other baseline/date/duration conditions exist. Retained pre-existing cloud fields can affect native behavior; the bridge does not claim to calculate or disable Xiaomi's baseline.

implemented_experiment.user_label_zh_cn: 睡眠区间 RMSSD 样本摘要
implemented_experiment.association: Use only samples from the chosen source with one uniquely matching same-source sleep interval. Exclude samples timestamped in known awake, awake-in-bed or out-of-bed stages. Missing/unknown phases produce an interval-assumption warning. A sample exactly at waking may be used only for a unique interval, with that warning.
implemented_experiment.calculation: Arithmetic mean, minimum and maximum of eligible HC RMSSD samples, rounded to nearest whole millisecond for avg_hrv/min_hrv/max_hrv. This is not pooled overnight RMSSD or an established Xiaomi-native algorithm.
implemented_experiment.source_quality: Enforce HC's documented 1–200 ms source range without clamping. Latest source revision wins; invalid latest values do not revive older values. Duplicate identical source/time/value points count once. Conflicting revisions, conflicting same-time values, missing sleeps or overlapping ambiguous sleeps are rejected.
implemented_experiment.payload: Preserve the complete base sleep timeline; add only avg_hrv, min_hrv and max_hrv. Do not synthesize a baseline, score, quantiles, standard deviation, analysis timestamp, daily HRV aggregate or detailed curve.
implemented_experiment.algorithm_provenance_limit: Experimental RMSSD meaning is exposed through bridge warnings and the HC/model source. No undocumented algorithm metadata field is invented in Xiaomi's cloud payload.
implemented_experiment.existing_row_policy: Enrichment of an existing row needs owned-upload provenance and the exact recorded cloud fingerprint, or an explicit legacy-record permission. The base sleep must agree and all three HRV fields must be absent. Retain all cloud value fields; re-read the original fingerprint/offset before POST. Never replace another source or a differing existing HRV summary.
implemented_experiment.verification: A durable pending journal precedes upload. Readback must verify persistence. HTTP acceptance alone and cloud readback alone do not prove official-app visibility or native algorithm equivalence.

chain: RemoteImpl searches bind/local/unbind device lists by exact did; absent matches return null
DeviceInfo.isPhone compares model, ignoring case, with mihlth.xiaomi.fitness.phone
DeviceRequest.recordDevices sends the phone model plus getUniqueIdentify and obtains DeviceRecordInfo.sid from the service
default_source_phone_resolution.finding: No local hardcoded default -> phone mapping was found in this path. The account device lists and server-assigned SID remain runtime inputs.
default_source_phone_resolution.policy: Retain sid=default from the tested importer contract. Do not fabricate a wearable device identity or claim that the HRV panel must be visible or hidden.
